sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 681 (ten loops, 199 of 205 campsites parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included; DEC's 2026 summary sets a 1-night reservation minimum here. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register 2-9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

values.note: DEC lists 217 sites; ReserveAmerica sells 205 campsites plus 5 group sites: of 199 read, 171 are listed as 30-ft back-ins, 18 at 40 ft, 2 at 20 ft. Sites range from tall pines to the open, sandy shoreline.

sites.source: https://dec.ny.gov/sites/default/files/2025-04/summerreccampgroundsummary.pdf ('Northampton Beach 518-863-6000 217') + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 681 ('30 Back-In' 171, '40 Back-In' 18, '20 Back-In' 2, 'Back-In' 8 among campsites; 'Campsite (205)', 'Group Camp (5)') + campground page ('Campsites range from those secluded within the tall white pines and northern hardwoods, to those on the open, sandy shoreline'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/northampton-beach-campground/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=681 ('restrooms with showers, a trailer dump station, a recycling center, a boat launch, and a sand beach'), read 2026-10-21

note: DEC campground on the northwest corner of Great Sacandaga Lake, a reservoir; sandy beach, large boat launch, and campsites from the pines to the open shoreline. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $22 + $5 non-resident and the 1-night reservation minimum (DEC 2026 summary), 2027 season May 14 - Oct 10 (matches; DEC 2026 May 15 - Oct 12), ReserveAmerica 9-month window and 14-night max (DEC row, now on the entry). Added 217 sites to 40 ft, no electric, showers, dump. Note reworded with the page's setting (no field facts).
